episodes.title: Episode 13: Fear, Fearmongering, and the State of the World
episodes.description: What's up, sinners? Welcome to Episode 13 of Clothesline, the lighthearted, dark-humoured podcast about growing up in cults. We're Chris and Syd, two nonbinary people in their 30s who grew up homeschooled in fundamentalist evangelical Christian purity culture. Although we covered a lot of different subjects in this episode, they all had the same root once we dug into them: fear. Some of the topics in this episode include: * “The end is near” narrative we grew up with: is there any truth to it? * How social media and fearmongering play a part in locking people into this headspace * Negative vs. positive motivation for change and self-development * Cat break (featuring Connie, our mascot) * Syd accuses Chris of not dissociating hard enough * A reminder that stupider people have done the same things with less …and more. Wanna talk to us? All our links are below, or email us at clotheslinepod@gmail.com . Spread Clothesline's Good News by sharing this episode with your buddies! As promised, here are the links: Subscribe to us on Substack: https://clotheslinepod.substack.com/ Support Clothesline on Patreon! https://www.patreon.com/cw/ClotheslinePod Chris's Substack: https://crisiscorner.substack.com/ Chris's other podcast, Pickles and Vodka: A Mental Health Podcast (available wherever you listen): https://picklesandvodka.substack.com/ Chris's other links: https://xcjumperx.carrd.co/ Follow Syd on Threads: https://www.threads.com/@houseghostcreative All of Syd's links: https://houseghostcreative.carrd.co/ Disclaimer: This episode includes conversations about things like religious trauma, mental health, abuse, and other topics like that. We aren't doctors or psychologists. This podcast is not intended to give official advice or anything serious. We're simply here to share our stories and talk about these things in a very real and human way. Our intention is for you to feel less alone, less crazy, and more supported. To hear more, visit clotheslinepod.substack.com
